tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// bsngo ba'i yon bshad pa phan bde'i 'bras bu rab tu rgyas byed byang chub kyi ljon pa bzhugs so//

"$ ༄༅// de lta bu'i sgo nas dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga rdo rje phreng ba'i rgyud sde rgya mtsho'i dkyil 'khor cha tshang ma'i smin byed legs par grub pa ste/ de yang grub pa'i slob dpon pad+ma sam+bha bas rdzu 'phrul gyi zhabs kyis bcags shing sbas pa'i gnas su byin gyis rlabs pa dang*/ rgyal ba lo ras pa/ grub pa'i dbang phyug 'brug sgom zhig po/ 'brug smyon kun dga' legs pa sogs sngon byon grub pa'i skyes mchog du ma dang*/ khyad par zhabs drung chos kyi rgyal po ngag dbang rnam rgyal ba'i thugs bskyed rmad du byung ba'i 'phrin las gyi dpal las don brgyud dpal ldan 'brug pa'i ring lugs dri ma med pa dar rgyas su gyur pa'i bshad sgrub kyi snang ba dkar po nub pa med pas yongs su 'khyud pa'i lho mon kha bzhi chos kyi zhing sa gang 'dir/ rgyal sras dpa' bo'i rnam thar bdag gir bzhes shing*/ yangs pa'i sa chen po chos bzhin du skyong ba'i stobs kyi 'khor los sgyur ba/ 'brug rgyal bzhi pa 'jigs med seṅge dbang phyugaskal bzang chos sgron yum sras zhal lhan rgyas thugs bskyed dam bca' btsan pos/ smin byed sgrub pa'i gzhi len gnang ba'i bdag rkyen bla na med pa la brten nas/ dpal ldan 'brug pa yab sras kyi thugs kyi sras su bzung zhing mkhas dang grub pa'i rnam thar bgrang ba las 'das pas gangs ljongs mdo khams kyi phyogs su don brgyud bstan ba'i bdag por rdo rje'i lung gis mnga' gsol ba'i/ dpal rgyal ba mdo khams pa zhes pa'i mtshan gyi dbyangs snyan srid zhi'i 'jigs 'phrog skabs gsum rgyan du snyan par dpyangs ba tshad ma'i skyes bu sku rabs rim par byon pa'i/ sku skye ba'i phreng ba brgyad par/ mchog gzigs yab sras rnams kyis rdo rje'i lung gis dbugs dbyung ba thob pa'i mtshan gyi byin rlabs tsam las/ spangs rtogs kyi yon tan cha phra mos kyang dbul zhing*/

snyigs dus kyi btsun gzugs dred por shor ba bdag lta bus/ rdo rje gsang ba sngags kyi chos tshul zab mo 'di 'dra ba'i smin grol gyi sgo 'phar 'byed ba ni tshul dang mthun pa ma lags mod kyang*/ bdag cag gi skyabs gcig mthu chen rdo rje 'dzin pa brgyad pa mthu stobs chos kyi rgya mtsho'i bka' drin las chos tshul 'di nyid kyi smin byed byin rlabs kyi brgyud pa ma nyams pas bdag gi rgyud yongs su brtas par byas par kho na tsam rgyu mtshan du byas/ dus snyigs ma rtags tsam 'dzin pa'i bstan pa'i mtha' la sleb dus rgyud sde rin po che 'di dag gi mtshan tsam 'dzin zhing thos pa tsam skal pa dge zhing*/ rnyed dka' ba'i rgyu mtshan la bsam nas spyi brtol bskyed de/ rdo rje slob dpon chen po'i go sa bzung ste/ mchog gi rdo rje'i rig pa 'dzin pa mkhas grub rgya mtsho'i dbang phyug mkhyen brtse rdo rje 'chang sogs/ bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen tshad dang ldan pa mchog gi sprul pa'i sku rnams dang*/ rig grol gyi yon tan bzang pos mdzes pa'i dge 'dun rgya mtsho lta bu 'dus pa'i gong du 'khod nas/ zab chos yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin thang gi tshad kyis phongs pa gram thang du brdal ba lta bu rdo rje gsang chen rgyud sde du ma'i bcud 'dus shing*/ ma dang mkha' 'gro yongs kyi snying khrag gi dwangs ma/ 'phags bod grub rigs bye ba'i thugs kyi gsang mdzod bla na med pa/ dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga rdo rje phreng ba zhes mtshan tsam yang thos shing rnyed dka' ba 'di nyid grub pa'i slob dpon chen po a bha ya chen po'i bzhed gzhung ma rnyogs pa/ sngon gyi 'phags bod kyi mkhas grub phreng ba mkhan po rnams kyi bka' srol dang phyag len gyi rgyun/ g.yo las dang rang 'dod kyi rtog bzo ham bcos sogs kyis ma sbag par/ rang gi shes yon blo nus dang dpags pa'i gtsang dag sel med ru nga bas hur brtson stobs su bskyed de legs par bsgrubs pa'i bya ba rlabs po che mtha' rgyas su grub pa 'di ni rang gzhan 'dir 'dus pa thams cad tshe rabs sngon nas rnam dkar gyi bsags rgyab shin tu dge ba'i mthu dang smon lam gcig tu mthun pa'i stobs kyis bstan pa gcig dang ston pa gcig gi rjes su slob cing*/

rdo rje theg pa'i smin grol bla na med pa'i chos kyi dga' ston 'di lta bur longs su spyod pa'i dge ba'i las 'di ni ches mchog dang rab dang phul du gyur pa'i tshogs gnyis rin po che ma 'bad lhun grub gyi tshul du bsags pa yin pas/ de lta bu'i dge ba'i bya ba rlabs po che yongs su bsngo bas rgyas 'debs pa ni shin tu gal che ba ni/ lung las/ bsod nams byas pa'i tshogs dag ni// sems can kun la yongs bsngo ba// thub pa khyed kyis gang gsungs pa// de bzhin bstan bcos las ma bshad// ces byas shing bsags pa'i dge ba thams cad mi 'dzad cing gong du spel ba la thabs bla na med pa yin pas/ de lta bu'i dge rtsa'ang sbyin pa thams cad kyi mchog tu gyur pa legs bshad chos kyi dga' ston 'gyed pa chos kyi sbyin pa yin zhing*/ de'i rjes su 'brel par gyur pa/ longs spyod la chags pa med cing bsod nams kyi tshogs rlabs po che rdzogs pa byed pa zang zing gis sbyin pa dang*/ gnyis kas bsdus pa zhig yin pas/ de yang ji ltar bsngo ba'i yul ni mar gyur pa'i sems can nam mkha'i mthas gtug pa dag la dmigs yul du byas te gzhan don du byang chub dam pa thob 'dod kyi blos kun nas blangs te de bzhin du gsal 'debs par zhu/ bsngo ba'i dpang po ni/ mdun gyi phyogs 'dir bcom ldan 'das dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i dkyil 'khor chen po'i lha tshogs gtso bor bzhugs pa'i/ rab 'byams rgyud sde bzhi'i dkyil 'khor zhi ba dang khro bo'i rnam rol sna tshogs su 'char ba'i bsam yas sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i lha tshogs rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma/ gnas gsum gyi dpa' bo dang ḍā ki ye shes dang las las grub pa'i mthu chen rdo rje chos skyong ba'i srung ma'i dbang po'i tshogs kyis mtha' bskor/ grub pa dang drang srong lha dang rig 'dzin bden tshig grub par bcas pa'i dkon mchog rtsa ba gsum gyi tshogs sprin gyi phung po ltar bzhugs pa dag gis/

bdag cag la thugs brtse ba chen pos rjes su nye bar dgongs shing*// ji ltar bsngos shing smon pa'i don thams cad 'grub pa'i bden tshig mthun 'gyur gnang bzhin bzhugs par mos pa dang chab gcig dge 'dun 'dus pa rgya mtshos kyang thugs 'dun rtse gcig pa bcas mthun 'gyur 'di bzhin thugs la 'dogs par zhu/ rab 'byams zhing gi rdul gyi grangs dang mnyam pa'i phyogs bcu dus bzhir bzhugs pa'i rgyal dang de sras slob mar bcas pa ma lus thams cad dang*/ dpal bcom ldan 'das dus kyi 'khor lo/ phyi nang gzhan gsum gyi dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs/ rab 'byams rgyud sde bzhi'i gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa ma lus pa thams cad bdag dang sbyin pa'i bdag po chos skyong ba'i rgyal po 'jigs med seṅge dbang phyug skal bzang chos sgron yum sras 'brel ba dang bcas pa'i thog drangs/ nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad la dgongs su gsol/ bdag cag gis deng 'dir legs par bsags pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba 'dis mtshon byed du byas/ bdag gzhan dus gsum du byas dang byed 'gyur gyi dge ba'i tshogs ma lus pa gzhan gyis zil gyis mi non par bla na med pa'i byang chub kyi bar de srid du gong nas gong du 'phel zhing rgyas la zad mi shes pas yongs su gang bar gyur cig de lta bu'i dge ba'i rtsa ba rlabs che dag gi mthu las/ phan bde'i 'byung gnas sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rin po che phyogs dang ris su ma chad pa dar zhing rgyas la yun ring du gnas par gyur cig khyad par du yang don brgyud snying po dpal ldan 'brug pa'i bstan pa rin po che gser sbyang btso ma lta bu la/ snga 'gyur theg pa'i bstan mchog baiḍūr+ya nor bu'i phra tshoms kyis rnam par bkra ba'i snying po'i bstan mchog zung du 'jug pa'i lung rtogs kyi bdag nyid 'di nyid bshad dang sgrub pa rnyed pa dang bkur sti mtha' yas pa dang bcas pas sgo kun nas dar zhing rgyas la yun ring du gnas par gyur cig

thub bstan spyi dang bye brag gi gsal byed dam par gyur cig snyigs dus kyi 'gro ba'i skyabs gnas dam par gyur pa'i mchog gzigs tshad ma'i skyes bu gang nas bzhugs pa thams cad sku tshe yun du brtan zhing*/ bstan dang 'gro ba'i don du sman pa'i mdzad 'phrin gyi 'khor lo nam mkha'i khyon dang mnyam par gyur cig chos sde chen po 'di nyid kyis mtshon pa'i phyogs bcu'i 'phags pa'i dge 'dun gyi sde ma lus pa gang na su bzhugs pa thams cad 'khrugs rtsod sogs bdud kyi las dang bral zhing*/ bslab pa gsum gyis rgyud phyug pa dang*/ thos bsam sgom gsum/ 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum/ bshad sgrub las gsum gyi sgo nas rang dang gzhan gyi don gnyis lhun gyis grub pa'i 'phrin las mkha' dang mnyam par gyur cig de dag gi mthu la brten nas 'dzam gling yangs pa'i rgyal khams na spyod pa'i skye dgu ma lus pa la yang dag pa'i lta ba dang*/ byang chub kyi sems ngang ngam shugs kyis rgyud la skyes te/ chags sdang dang phrag dog gi rgyu rkyen las byung ba'i 'thab 'khrugs 'khon rtsod la sogs pa'i bsam sbyor ngan pa rang sar zhi zhing*/ thams cad zhi bde'i dpal la dus rtag tu longs spyod/ khyad par du lho phyogs nor 'dzin chos kyi zhing sa 'di nyid chos bzhin du skyong ba'i mnga' bdag stobs kyi 'khor los sgyur ba 'jigs med seṅge dbang phyug sku ngo ltos par bcas pa mchog la gnas skabs mthar thug gi 'gal rkyen mi dang mi min gyi bsam sbyor gdug rtsub phyi nang gis bar du gcod pa ma lus pa'i stobs nus rtsad nas choms te/ mi mthun phyogs ma lus pa rmig med rang sar nye bar zhi bar gyur cig mthun pa'i rkyen sku tshe dang bsod nams stobs dang mnga' thang dpal 'byor thams cad yar zla ltar 'phel zhing rgyas la brtan par gyur cig kha bzhi lho ljongs chos kyi rgyal khab chen po'i chab srid kyi mdzad 'phrin 'dzam gling zhi bde'i rgyal khab yongs kyi bla na mngon par brjid cing*/

snyan grags kyi bla res phyogs kun tu khyab par chos dang mthun pa'i 'phrin las rnam bzhi'i rtsal 'chang ba'i mthu stobs kyis gzhan sde zil gyis gnon pa dang*/ tshar gcod pa dang dbang du sdud pas phyogs thams cad las rnam par rgyal ba'i dge mtshan nub pa med par yun du brtan par gyur cig chab 'og tu gtogs pa'i skye dgu kun kyang dkon mchog rin po che gtsug tu bkur zhing mi mthun pa med par zhi zhing mdza' la phan pa'i bsam sbyor dang ldan pas rnam dkar gyi las la gcig tu 'grub pas phan bde mi zad pa'i gter la longs spyod par/ chab 'bangs thams cad chos dang mthun pa'i bka' khrims drangs la btsan pos bskyangs te rje 'bangs dam tshig gtsang ba'i byams brtse'i mdza' ba'i 'ching thag nam yang mi lhod pas bde skyid dgung dang mnyam pas dus rtag tu gnas par gyur cig snyigs ma'i rang rtags las shar ba'i nad mtshon mu ge rgud pa'i skal ba ngan pa thams cad gtan nas med par= lha dang srung ma dkar po'i phyogs skyong ba rnams kyi dbu 'phang dgung du mtho zhing sdong grogs dang srung skyob mi g.yel bas rtag par skyong bar gyur cig nag phyogs bdud rigs kyi mthu stobs nus pa rtsad nas nyams shing log par 'khu ba'i gnod sbyor gang gis kyang mi tshugs pas 'gal rkyen mtshan ma'i g.yul la rnam par rgyal bar gyur cig rang gzhan kun la bzang ngan gi 'brel ba thogs shing*/ dmigs yul tshe las 'das tshad thams cad bar do dang ngan song gi 'jigs dang sdug bsngal las grol te/ bde ba can dang pad+ma 'od/ mngon par dga' ba sogs dag pa'i zhing mchog dag tu dka' tshegs med par bsgrod nas sa lam gyi spangs rtogs yon tan khyad par can rgyud la skye bar gyur cig mthar yang tshogs gnyis rdzogs sgrib gnyis byang nas myur du gtan gyi bde ba rdzogs pa sangs rgyas pa'i go 'phang dam pa thob par= sngon gyi rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa rnams kyi ji ltar bsngos pa dang*/

ma 'ongs 'byung 'gyur rnams kyi ji ltar bsngo bar 'gyur ba dang*/ da ltar bzhugs pa rnams kyis ji ltar bsngo ba mdzad pa de bzhin/ bdag gis kyang de dag gi rjes su slob ste 'khor gsum dmigs pa med pa'i tshul gyis yongs su bsngo bar bgyi na de de bzhin du 'grub par gyur cig rab rgyal shing stag spyi lo 1974 la 'brug thim phug bkra shis chos gling du/ dpal rdo rje phreng ba'i smin byed rgyas par gnang grub pa'i skabs su stsal ba'o// ༈ bsngo ba'i yon bshad legs byas bskyed pa'i gter bzhugs so// blo gros mi zad pa'i zhus pa'i mdo las// ji ltar rgya mtsho che nang chu thig lhung*// rgya mtsho ma zad bar du de mi 'dzad// de bzhin byang chub yongs bsngo dge ba gang*// byang chub ma thob bar du de mi 'dzad// ces gsungs pa ltar/ byas shing bsags pa'i dge tshogs rnams byang chub ma thob kyi bar mi 'dzad cing*/ gong nas gong du 'phel bar 'gyur ba'i phyir/ des na byang chub kyi rgyu drung po yongs su bsngo ba ni shin tu nas kyang gal che bar gsungs pa'i phyir na/ bsngo ba'i rim pa 'di bzhin du thugs la 'dogs par zhu/ de yang mdun gyi nam mkhar bla ma rgyal ba dkon mchog spyi 'dus 'jam dpal rigs gsum khros pa dus dgra'i dbang po khro chu dug gdong nag po'i dkyil 'khor chen po'i lha tshogs ma lus pa thams cad sogs deng 'dir bdag cag yon mchod rnams kyis legs par bsags pa'i dge tshogs rgya cher bkrun pa nyid kyis mtshon nas bdag gzhan dus gsum bsags dang yod pa'i dge tshogs ma lus pa gzhan gyis zil gyis mi non par bla na med pa'i byang chub kyi bar de srid du gong nas gong du 'phel zhing rgyas la zad mi shes pas yongs su gang bar gyur cig phan bde'i 'byung gnas rgyal ba mnyam med zas gtsang sras kyi bstan pa rin po che spyi dang khyad par/ dwags brgyud bstan pa'i snying po don brgyud dpal ldan dbyar rnga pa'i bstan pa sa gsum na 'gran zla dang bral ba'i mchod sdong chen po 'di nyid dang*/

o rgyan mtsho 'khrungs rgyal ba'i ring lugs dri ma med pa lung dang rtogs pa'i bdag nyid can bshad sgrub las gsum gyi sgo nas rnyed pa dang bkur sti mtha' yas pa dang bcas pas phyogs dus gnas skabs thams cad du dar zhing rgyas la yun ring du= bstan dang 'gro ba'i mgon dpung dam par gyur pa'i mchog gzigs tshad ma'i skyes bu ris su ma chad pa gang na su bzhugs pa rnams kyi sku tshe 'chi bdag sbyin skyes kyi g.yul las rnam par rgyal te gzhan phan 'phrin las kyi 'khor los phyogs kun dus rtag tu khyab par= phyogs bcu'i 'phags pa'i dge 'dun gyi sde ma lus pa bslab pa gsum gyis rgyud dul zhing spang klog gi bya bas dus 'da' ba dang*/ 'khrugs rtsod la sogs bdud kyi las kyis nam yang mi 'khrugs par/ sku tshe brtan zhing gzhan phan byang chub spyod pa rgya mtshos gzhan gyi don 'bad med du bsgrubs pas dus 'da' bar= yangs pa'i sa chen gyi skye dgu kun dang*/ khyad par kha bzhi lho yi sman ljongs 'di nyid chos bzhin skyong ba'i mi dbang stobs kyis 'khor los sgyur dbang 'jigs med seṅge dbang phyug skal bzang chos kyi sgron ma/ bsod nams chos sgron/ bde chen dbang mo sogs/ chab srid 'phrin las kyi byed po ba bcas pa thams cad kyi gnas skabs mi 'dod pa'i nyer 'tshe nad gdon byad phur 'gal rkyen bar chad 'jigs pa brgyad dang bcu drug sogs nye bar zhi bar= tshe dang bsod nams dbang thang gzi brjid mthu stobs dbang phyug lugs gnyis kyi mkhyen rlabs snyan grags 'phrin las thams cad 'phel zhing rgyas par= chos srid lugs gnyis kyis mdzes pa'i rgyal khab chen po'i chab srid kyi dbu rmog btsan zhing*/ mnga' thang snyan grags 'dzam gling rgyal khab yongs kyi bla na mngon par mtho bzhin pas chab srid kyi dpal yon 'gyur ba med par brtan par= rje yi byams pas 'bangs 'khor bde bar skyong zhing*/

'bangs kyi gus pas rje dpon gtsug gi nor bur bsten nas dus kun rje 'bangs dam tshig 'gyur ba med pa bkra shis pa'i dge legs snang bas dus kun tu shis par= kun kyang dkar po dge ba bcu'i las lam la yang dag par 'grub cing*/ mi dge sdig pa'i las las byol nas gnas skabs snyigs ma'i rgud pa nad mug mtshon 'khrugs kyi skal ba ngan pa thams cad kyi ming tsam yang mi grags par= dal 'byor gyi rten bzang po tshe chos 'byor stobs kyi mi 'bras bzang pos phyugs nas/ 'di dang gtan gyi phan pa dang bde ba'i bgo skal bzang po la rtag tu longs spyod par= lho mon chos kyi zhing 'dir pha rol gzugs can gzugs med sde dang bcas pa'i 'gal rkyen bsam sbyor log pa'i chab srid mnga' thang gi dpal la 'khu ba/ byad phur rbod gtong rtsom pa/ mi kha bra mchu dbyen dkrugs sel ngan bskyed pa la sogs pa'i bar chad mi mthun pa'i phyogs gang gis kyang dus nam yang mi tshugs par= bcom ldan 'jam dpal mi shigs sra brtan dug gdong 'bar ba'i srung 'og tu chud par= mthar thug rang gzhan sems can thams cad kyi 'khrul rtog nyon mongs pa'i sgrib pa bag chags dang bcas pa bcom ldan 'das 'jam dpal khros pa'i ye shes thugs rje'i gzi byin gyis dmigs med du bcom nas/ zung 'jug blo 'das 'jam dpal ye shes sems dpa'i go 'phang dam pa tshe gcig lus gcig gis thob par gyur cig de ltar bsngo zhing smon pa'i rim pa'ang*/ dus gsum gshegs dang 'byon gyur sras bcas rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i rnam thar gyi rjes su slob ste 'khor gsum dmigs pa med pa'i tshul gyis yongs su bsngo bar bgyi na de de bzhin du 'grub par gyur cig/

rab rgyal shing yos spyi lo 1975 zla 9 tshes 30 la 'brug bum thang sku rjes su gzhung gi zhabs rim du 'jam dpal khro chu'i sgo nas bsad mdos mtha' rgyas bcas gnang ba'i mjug thog tu stsal ba'o/// / ༈ bdag sogs sems can thams cad dus rtag par bla ma la skyabs su mchi'o// sangs rgyas la= chos la = dge 'dun la = mi mchog rgyal ba dus gsum gshegs pa dang*// khyad par bde gshegs dbang po sum cu lngar// gus pas phyag 'tshal skyabs gsol thugs rjes dgongs// mi shes ma gus bag med nyon mongs pas// tshe rabs byas bsags sdig ltung mi 'chab bshags// gnong 'gyod slad chad mi bgyi dam bca' 'o// bdag gzhan dus gsum legs bsags ci mchis dngos// 'gro phyir sras bcas rgyal ba'i rnam thar bzhin// byang chub snying por yongs su bsngo bgyi na// rgyal sras spyod rdzogs sangs rgyas myur thob shog/ ces phung po gsum pa'i mdo'i don bsdus kyi tshul du/ dge bsnyen ma dam chos dpal mo'i ched du/ khams sprul brgyad ming pas bris pa dge legs 'phel// //
